einzeiler: Revisiting the summer movie confidence scale to see which blockbusters hit or flopped.
kurzfassung: The hosts review their pre-summer box office confidence rankings alongside guest Scott Mendelson. They analyze the hits, misses, and overall recovery of the summer 2026 box office. Finally, Craig tallies the scores to determine who won the predictions.
stichpunkte: Domestic summer box office finished significantly ahead of the pre-pandemic average and last year.
Devil Wears Prada 2 outperformed expectations and became a massive box office hit.
Mortal Kombat 2 struggled internationally, leading to underwhelming overall box office results.
Mandalorian and Grogu became the lowest-grossing Star Wars movie ever in theaters.
Masters of the Universe flopped theatrically despite performing well on Prime Video.
Toy Story 5 and Spider-Man Brand New Day delivered massive box office numbers.
Supergirl and Moana underperformed and ranked among the summer's biggest bombs.
The Odyssey emerged as a major cultural event and a massive financial success.
